findings.resolution: Thai/Lao Nikhahit/AA decomposition and above-mark reorder, with derived coverage preflight

findings.problem: Expanded Myanmar multiple substitution grows indefinitely
findings.resolution: Advance contextual cursor over inserted output glyphs; avoid skipping multiplied base glyphs during mark positioning

findings.problem: Tibetan old USE U+0F71 and broken cluster placement
findings.resolution: CMBlw classification and dotted circle before the first non-repha mark

findings.problem: Large reference JSON corrupts UTF-8 across pipe chunks and exceeds guarded output cap
findings.resolution: Stream UTF-8 decoder; test-only batches of 100 keep original 500000-character output cap
U frame matrices select the pinned script font as primary; full mixed reference selects the covering Lao font before DejaVu
Expected wording corrected; earlier 142/143 run excluded; complete 143/143 rerun with terminal summary and every case receipt verified.

knownGaps: 14 modern Lao test letters absent from pinned NotoSansLao font (112 generated diagnostic strings); rejected rather than counted as matches
